en: Vintage black-and-white postcard view of a wooden church complex in a rural lakeside landscape. The main church has a steep, hipped roof with a small belfry on top and scaffolding or ladders leaning against the roof, suggesting maintenance work. To the right stands a separate bell tower. In the foreground are fields with haystacks and a wooden fence. Finnish text is printed below the image.
